Soundcore App: ?Choose from 22 EQ presets select a suitable level of noise cancelling and transparency set volume level limits customize the controls and more. Multipoint Connection:? name: Bombay Oud Eau De Parfum For Men 80ml
description: Bombay Oud Perfume Delivered All Over Pakistan Vendor brings you the best price for Ahmed Bombay Oud Eau De Parfum For Men 80ml with express shipping all over Pakistan. Details: A captivating blend of oriental spices and rich woods, Bombay Oud transports you to the bustling and nostalgic streets of Mumbai. Bombay Oud is a fragrance that is said to be inspired by the city of Mumbai (formerly known as Bombay) in India. It is typically described as a woody, floral, and musky scent with notes of oud (also known as agarwood), sandalwood, rose, and amber. Oud is a highly sought-after ingredient in perfumery and is known for its warm, earthy, and slightly smoky aroma. The combination of oud and sandalwood in Bombay Oud is said to create a rich, luxurious, and long-lasting fragrance that is suitable for anyone. EDP 80ML. Top Notes: Orange Sicilian: The zesty and fresh aroma of orange is the first thing that hits the nose upon initial application. It adds a bright and lively opening to the fragrance. Rose: The floral and sweet aroma of rose adds a romantic and feminine touch to the scent. The rose note is well balanced with the orange note and it enhances the overall freshness of the fragrance. Heart Notes: Sandalwood: The warm and woody aroma of sandalwood adds a comforting and inviting touch to the scent. It creates a smooth and creamy texture that is both soothing and grounding. Pear: The fruity and juicy aroma of pear adds a subtle sweetness to the scent. It gives the fragrance a slight fruity note that is well balanced with the woody and leather notes. Leather: The rich and earthy aroma of leather adds a masculine and refined touch to the scent. It gives the fragrance a strong and bold character that is both sensual and warm. Base Notes: Musk: The clean and musky aroma of musk provides a deep and long-lasting finish to the scent. It adds a personal and animalistic dimension to the fragrance. Amber: The warm and resinous aroma of amber adds a rich and opulent touch to the scent. It gives the fragrance a smooth and creamy texture that is both comforting and grounding. Benzoin: The sweet and vanilla-like aroma of benzoin adds a subtle sweetness to the scent. It enhances the overall warmth and coziness of the fragrance. Oud Accords: The rich and warm aroma of oud is the signature note of the fragrance. It adds a deep and mysterious dimension to the scent. Its considered one of the most sought after ingredients in perfumery, its used to provide an earthy, woody and musky aroma to the fragrance. Together, these notes create a harmonious and complex fragrance that evokes the spirit of the city of Mumbai. The scent is versatile and can be worn by both men and women, and its perfect for special occasions or a night out. The longevity and sillage of the fragrance is great, it lasts on the skin for hours and its easy to detect the different notes as the fragrance evolves over time. name: Devialet Phantom I 108DB Gold - Qatar
description: Devialet Phantom I 108DB GoldEnjoy powerful wireless audio with the gold Devialet Phantom I 108 dB Wireless Speaker. It outputs up to 1100W of RMS power and features Wi-Fi, AirPlay 2, and Bluetooth wireless connectivity, plus an optical input and wired Ethernet. Spotify Connect is also onboard, and the Phantom I can be controlled wirelessly by the Devialet app.From Revolution to ReferencePhantom embodies the vision Devialet has been working towards: elevating sound to its rightful place in our lives, providing audiences around the world with a uniquely intricate and moving listening experience. Phantom has been revolutionizing the speaker game since its release, and has gone on to become a reference for acoustic excellence. By combining a series of radical patented technologies, Phantom consistently shatters expectations, at every step of the sound reproduction chain. Zero distortion, zero saturation, zero background noise.Instant ConnectionWhether you're used to Bluetooth or Wi-Fi, optical or analog, Phantom's open architecture lets you get straight to the music you love.AirPlay 2: Apple users can enjoy an additional layer of control over their Phantom with AirPlay 2. Create a custom multiroom set-up by directly streaming audio from the control device (iPhone or iPad) to numerous AirPlay 2-connected speakers, including the Phantom.Spotify Connect: Spotify users can stream their favorite playlists on their favorite speaker with the help of Spotify Connect. All that's needed? The app and a Wi-Fi connection.Roon Ready: In addition to UPnP and the analog/optical input, Phantom owners are able to enjoy 24-bit-sample-rate music using Roon's streaming protocol. Phantom connects to Roon seamlessly, without any configuration steps, allowing users to enjoy perfect hi-res sound with ease.UPnP: With Universal Plug and Play, or UPnP, users can switch to a third-party application to play music hosted on their local networks. In other words, with the help of a UPnP controller application, Phantom is able to communicate with an external hard drive.Expand Your HorizonsThe only thing better than a Phantom? Two. In stereo, the Phantom's soundstage expands even further and listening takes on a new dimension as the speakers dance in absolute synchronicity. More extreme, more powerful, more exhilarating. It is an unthinkably immersive experience. When combined, Phantoms become the most compact high-end stereo system on the market. Hint: stand in the middle and you'll feel like you're center stage. Really.Your Music, Where You Want ItSync your entire home in symphony or stream something different in every room thanks to your Devialet App (for iOS and Android). With Multiroom, there are now even more ways to play:Multi-Zone Play lets you group any Phantoms and feel the sound sing throughout your space.Single-Zone Play lets you mix and match your Phantoms in a single space for a next-level sound experience.Individual Play lets you have jazz playing in the kitchen while a podcast is being devoured on the couch. And everyone can control their own volume and manage zones right from the Devialet App.Also note that the Phantom gives iOS users the option to also enjoy a multiroom set up through Airplay 2.The Devialet App: Your Sound, Your WayPower this unreasonable requires some control. Set up your Phantom, finetune your settings, and stay up to date, all via the Devialet App. An intuitive companion, the app lets you customize your Phantom experience: setting up your Phantom, adjusting latency for A/V, activating Standby Mode or customizing bass for Night Mode.Engineering ExcellenceDevialet thrives on end-to-end innovation (hardware, software, design inside and out, manufacturing) to offer ever-enhanced acoustics. In fact, to create Phantom, Devialet even built its own plant, hired talent that were used to unique challenges in other industries, and conceived their own robotics and quality control. Over 200 patents and over 90 awards later, Phantom speakers are, more than ever, in a class of their own.A Clear PathThe Phantom includes Devialet's powerful next-generation audio processing chip which helps deliver improved sound quality. Phantom's signal processing and amplification performance is embedded in a SoC (system on a chip), which was custom designed for optimal integration. The results? Enhanced heat dissipation for optimal performance at any volume, better energy efficiency, and barely measurable distortion, saturation, or noise.The Best of Both WorldsADH, or Analog Digital Hybrid, is Devialet's signature patented technology. In a truly groundbreaking feat, an analog amplifier teams up with four digital amplifiers. Working in parallel, the analog amplifier reproduces an unspoiled signal and sends it to the digital amplifiers, which are able to translate it digitally. In other words, ADH combines the sophistication of analog with the power and miniaturization of digital for the first time.Welcome to the Deep EndDeveloped exclusively for the Phantom, HBI, or Heart Bass Implosion, lets you feel infrabass frequencies all the way down to 14 Hz. Engineered to perform under extreme constraints, the Phantom's hermetically sealed architecture consists of two lateral woofers. When cued, they begin to dance in sync, creating opposing forces that cancel out even the slightest vibrations and generate ultra-dense sound, the kind your bones perceive before your ears. That's why you feel immersed in the Phantom: because you are, from head to toe.As the Artist IntendedSAM, or Speaker Active Matching, is a software algorithm designed to deliver extreme fidelity throughout playback while protecting your speaker. Whether you are dealing with transient or steady-state signals, SAM is able to process more information than previously thought possible. This enables the Phantom to reproduce the exact tempo of your music, at all frequencies. All of it, with absolute precision. So that you can experience every last emotion, just as the artist intended.Performance-Driven DesignThe Phantom's elegant curves are guided by acoustics over design. Inspired by Harry Ferdinand Olson's pulsating sphere principle, the Phantom's ACE, or Active Cospherical Engine, radically optimizes the way sound waves form and travel. Whether you’re looking for a powerful fitness companion, a stylish accessory, or a smart device that simplifies your daily life, this smartwatch offers the ideal solution. Packed with an extensive list of features and functionalities, the YES Network Smartwatch is designed to cater to your every need, ensuring you stay productive, entertained, and healthy. This smartwatch is equipped with a robust hardware configuration, including a Spretrum UWS8541E CPU, 3GB RAM, and 32GB internal storage. Its advanced heart rate sensor (HX3605) and comprehensive fitness tracking capabilities make it a reliable partner for maintaining your well-being. The high-definition AMOLED display ensures clear visuals, while the built-in Bluetooth and WiFi keep you seamlessly connected to your devices and networks. With support for 4G-LTE and a Nano SIM card, this smartwatch can function independently, reducing reliance on your smartphone. Design and Build Quality The YES Network Smartwatch is built to impress with its sleek and modern design. Crafted from a durable zinc alloy frame, it offers a premium look and feel, making it suitable for both casual and professional settings. The watch’s compact body dimensions (©49.5*13.6mm) ensure a comfortable fit on your wrist, while the soft, adjustable straps provide maximum comfort during extended wear. At just the right size, the 1.43-inch AMOLED display offers a resolution of 466*466 pixels, ensuring crystal-clear visuals and vibrant colors. The full-touch interface is highly responsive, making it easy to navigate through menus and apps. The addition of a magnetic charging feature (5V 1A) makes recharging quick and effortless, minimizing downtime and maximizing convenience. Display and User Interface The stunning AMOLED display is one of the standout features of the YES Network Smartwatch. Its 466*466 resolution delivers sharp, detailed visuals, making it ideal for a wide range of applications, from fitness tracking and notifications to multimedia playback. The always-on display ensures you can view essential information at a glance without needing to wake up the device manually. The user-friendly interface is powered by Android 8.1, offering seamless navigation and access to a wide range of apps. With support for downloadable apps via the Google Play Store, you can personalize the watch to suit your specific needs and preferences. The intuitive design ensures that even first-time users can quickly get accustomed to its functionality. Performance and Connectivity Under the hood, the YES Network Smartwatch is powered by the Spretrum UWS8541E processor, ensuring smooth and efficient performance. The 3GB RAM allows for seamless multitasking, while the 32GB internal storage provides ample space for apps, music, and other media files. The smartwatch supports 4G-LTE connectivity, allowing you to make calls, send messages, and browse the internet without the need for a smartphone. The inclusion of GPS (GLONASS, GPS, AGPS) ensures accurate location tracking, making it an ideal companion for outdoor activities and navigation. Additionally, Bluetooth 4.2 and WiFi (2.4GHz 802.11b/g/n) provide versatile connectivity options for syncing with other devices and networks. Health and Fitness Tracking The YES Network Smartwatch is equipped with a comprehensive suite of health and fitness tracking features, making it an essential tool for maintaining your well-being. The advanced HX3605 heart rate sensor provides accurate, real-time monitoring, while the blood oxygen measurement feature adds another layer of health tracking. These metrics are invaluable for assessing your overall fitness and detecting potential health issues early. Other fitness-focused features include a pedometer, calorie tracker, distance tracker, and sleep monitoring. The watch also supports multiple motion modes, allowing you to track a variety of activities, from running and cycling to yoga and swimming. The sedentary reminder and alarm features help you maintain a healthy routine by encouraging regular movement and timely activity. Multimedia and Entertainment The YES Network Smartwatch doubles as a multimedia device, offering support for audio playback in formats like MP3 and AAC. With its vibrant AMOLED display and video decoding capabilities, you can enjoy short video clips or review recorded footage directly on your wrist. The 32GB internal storage ensures you have enough space for your favorite songs and videos, making this smartwatch an excellent companion for on-the-go entertainment. Calling and Messaging Stay connected effortlessly with the YES Network Smartwatch’s robust calling and messaging features. The built-in Nano SIM card slot enables independent cellular connectivity, allowing you to make and receive calls directly from your watch. Bluetooth calling is also supported, providing an alternative for hands-free communication. The smartwatch includes a full-featured messaging system, complete with SMS functionality and support for various messaging apps. The addition of handwriting input makes composing messages on the go a breeze, while the ability to sync contacts and call history ensures you have all your important information at your fingertips. Battery Life and Charging The YES Network Smartwatch is powered by a 720mAh lithium polymer battery, providing long-lasting performance that keeps up with your busy lifestyle. Whether you’re using it for fitness tracking, multimedia playback, or cellular connectivity, the smartwatch ensures you stay powered throughout the day. The magnetic charging feature makes recharging simple and efficient, allowing you to get back to your activities quickly. Customization and Multi-Language Support The Android 8.1 operating system allows for extensive customization, enabling you to personalize the smartwatch to match your preferences. From watch faces to app configurations, the YES Network Smartwatch adapts to your unique style and needs. The multi-language support further enhances its usability, making it accessible to users from diverse regions around the world. Durability and Usability Designed to withstand the rigors of daily use, the YES Network Smartwatch is built with durability in mind. While it is not fully waterproof, its robust construction and -10? to 50? working temperature range ensure reliable performance in various conditions. The watch’s ergonomic design and lightweight construction make it comfortable to wear for extended periods, whether you’re working out or attending meetings. Conclusion The YES Network Smartwatch is a versatile and feature-packed device that delivers exceptional value. From its sleek design and powerful performance to its advanced health tracking and connectivity options, this smartwatch is designed to enhance every aspect of your life. Whether you’re a fitness enthusiast, a busy professional, or a tech-savvy individual, the YES Network Smartwatch offers a perfect blend of style, functionality, and innovation. With its comprehensive suite of features and robust build quality, the YES Network Smartwatch stands out as an essential accessory for modern living. Experience the future of wearable technology with the YES Network Smartwatch and elevate your lifestyle to new heights.

It's like our own little audio genie in every Flip 7. So now we can give you a better all-around sound without the added pounds. Same size bigger punch. Up to 16 hours of playtime Keep the mood alive for 14 hours on a single charge - and when we need to squeeze some extra juice out of our jubilee or another dance with our darling we can get an extra 2 hours with Playtime Boost. name: D-Link Wireless N300 Universal Range Extender
description: D-Link Wireless N300 Universal Range Extender The DAP-1325 N300 Wi-Fi Range Extender is a portable plug-in repeater that lets you extend an existing wireless network. Simply place it anywhere in your home to extend the range of your wireless network. Supporting Wireless N this tiny yet powerful N300 Wi-Fi Range Extender gives you connection speeds of up to 300 Mbps while still being backward compatible with your existing wireless devices. Extend Your Wireless Network Increase the coverage of your home wireless network with the sleek and easy-to-use DAP-1325 N300 Wi-Fi Range Extender. N300 technology helps to extend wireless range in your home or office and also provides backward compatibility with older wireless devices in your network allowing you to enjoy a fast reliable wireless connection. Alternatively use the built-in Fast Ethernet port and your homes existing wired Ethernet cabling to extend wireless coverage without worrying about signal strength. Easy to Set Up Easy to Use Setting up the N300 Wi-Fi Range Extender is simple. Just push the WPS push-button on the DAP-1325 and on the router or AP you want to extend and the DAP-1325 will automatically configure itself for you. Alternatively you can use the supported QRS Mobile app on your iPhone iPad or iPod touch or Android mobile device to set up the DAP-1325 easily without needing a computer. The N300 Wi-Fi Range Extender even includes a built-in setup wizard that lets you configure it both wired and wirelessly with a PC or mobile device. Mesh Smart Roaming with 802.11k/v 802.11k/v Mesh Smart Roaming allows your devices to intelligently switch to a stronger Wi-Fi signal as you move around the house. Pair with other routers or extenders that support the 802.11k/v standard to enjoy Mesh Smart Roaming throughout your home at all times. Compact Convenient Design The DAP-1325s compact design and intuitive setup make it perfect for use at home or in a small office. Simply plug it in and use the bright signal indicator LED to find the best location to extend your network. Its diminutive wall-plug design saves you the hassle of dealing with a power cord and its sleek unobtrusive appearance blends easily into the decor of any home or office.

name: JBL Charge 6 - Portable Waterproof and Drop-Proof
description: JBL Charge 6 - Portable Waterproof & Drop-Proof Like that newest season of our favorite show the JBL Charge is back and better than ever. The Charge 6 is everything we've come to love with new twists higher stakes and a bigger punch. With sound that slaps like never before better connectivity sturdier build and up to 28 hours of playtime the Charge 6 is a portable audio beast. How do we pack more sound in the same iconic portable speaker package? With some redesigned hardware and our brand new JBL AI Sound Boost - a clever audio processing algorithm we've included under the hood. The result? The Charge 6 hits way above its weight class filling our space with full rich immersive sound without taking more space on our table. The Charge 6 is also one of the toughest portable speakers out there. It's waterproof dustproof and drop-proof so it takes a beating without missing a beat. And true to its name the Charge 6 still includes a built-in power bank to charge your mobile device while you continue to jam out to your tunes. What could be better than a new JBL Charge 6 in our lives? How about two or four? Now we can effortlessly connect with other Auracast-enabled JBL speakers to cover more ground (and more ears) with the same playlist whether we're throwing the most sensational rooftop soiree or getting the crowd hyped before the ultimate pickleball tourney. This is the JBL Charge 6. Portable audio like we've never heard it before. Product details: Surprisingly rich powerful bass & crisp higher frequencies give the Charge 6 a whole new reason to humble brag. New proprietary tech AI Sound Boost which analyzes your music in real-time to deliver maximum acoustic performance with less distortion. Up to 28 hours of playtime: Keep the mood alive for 24 hours on a single charge and when we need to squeeze some extra juice out of our jubilee or another dance with our darling we can get an extra 4 hours with JBL Playtime Boost. Wouldn't it be great to share the vibes with our tribe? Now we can. With Auracast we can effortlessly stereo pair two Charge 6 speakers for a wider sound stage & connect multiple Auracast-enabled JBL speakers to cover more ground with the same playlist. On top of our legendary waterproof and dust-proof design (an industry-leading IP68 BTW) we've also made sure that if you drop it from 1 meter onto your concrete floor it'll keep kicking. Sturdy handle strap: Now we can carry our sound our way with a handy removable handle strap - for those of us who love to make it from the car to the house in one trip no matter the cost. Why is there no USB-C charging cable included with my product? To minimize e-waste we consciously choose not to include a charging cable in our packaging. However you can use any standard USB-C cable to charge your JBL product.
